title: An NPDo Approach for Tensor Block-Diagonalization
summary: This paper is concerned with Partial Tensor Block-Diagonalization of a multiway tensor by orthonormal matrices so that the extracted block-diagonal part optimally represents the tensor. The basic idea is to maximize the block-diagonal part via the tensor's mode-multiplications by orthonormal matrices. For that reason, it will be referred to Principal Tensor Block-Diagonalization (PTBD), which contains the Tucker decomposition (TD) of a tensor as a special case with just one block.
